questions.stem: Rahul, a 29-year-old journalist, is preparing a report on the structure of health care systems in India. As he reviews various sources, he comes across some descriptions of the levels of health care. He jots down a few statements but is unsure about the accuracy of one of them. Which of the following statements about the levels of health care is most incorrect?

options.label: A
options.text: Tertiary health care is generally provided in district hospitals.

options.label: B
options.text: Sound referral system is the fundamental function.

options.label: C
options.text: Secondary level of health care constitutes the first referral unit.

options.label: D
options.text: More specialized services are available at tertiary level.
